title: On Writing Well
author: William Zinsser
description: A working guide to writing clear non-fiction: cut clutter, find your voice, and respect the reader.
reasons: write anything for work and want it to be clearer
want practical advice on cutting clutter from your sentences
like craft books with a warm, opinionated voice
need a book you can reread a chapter at a time
dislikes: The chapters on specific forms such as sports and travel writing feel dated
Some examples lean on mid-century American references
